ENGINEERING MECHANICS STATICS

2/68 The force F is applied at the end of arm ACD, which is mounted to a vertical post.
Replace this single force F by an equivalent force-couple system at B. Next, redistribute
this force and couple by replacing it with two forces acting in the same direction as F,
one at C and the other at D, and determine the forces supported by the two hex-bolts.
Use values of F = 425 N, θ = 300 b = 1.9 m, d = 0.2 m, h = 0.8 m, and l = 2.75 m.
                        Given
                       To find : Force couple system
                            at B,
                             Fc, Fd
                           Solution
                      FB = -Fsinθi – Fcosθj
                  = - 425xsin30i – 425xcos30j
                  = - 212.5i – 368.06j kN
                  MB = Fsinθx(l-h) + Fcosθxb
                        1114.27=212.5x(2.75-              S V Venkatesh - Engineering Mechanics Statics - Unit 1 – Chapter – 2 – Force
                                            system                      0 8)+368 06x1 9
